scope: Root stochastic transport and cluster-F memory/quantum, excluding this researcher's cluster A
oracle_design: Event atoms, full unpartitioned block recurrence, independently multiplied Kraus matrices

hypotheses.joint_descent: Same coarse starting report must give the same JOINT successor-report/receipt law; marginal or posterior-only matches can fail.
hypotheses.history: Finite filtering should match an unnormalized path-atom calculation when each action descends and action choices depend only on the public history.
hypotheses.hidden_policy: A hidden-state-dependent action selector can break coarse-history transport even when each instrument separately descends.
hypotheses.conditional_stability: For two positive receipt masses alpha,beta, TV of conditional laws is at most TV of full laws divided by MAX(alpha,beta), with sharp unequal-mass examples.
hypotheses.memory: The direct full block recurrence equals convolution plus initial hidden forcing; omitting that initial term fails.
hypotheses.finite_kernel: Zero initial hidden state permits the asserted Ax+Eu law exactly when BD^kC and BD^kH vanish for 0<=k<h; Cayley-Hamilton, not a long finite run, supplies the infinite extension.
hypotheses.quantum: Identical current POVM effects determine only current probabilities. Different posterior-state maps can give incompatible future records.

preliminary_stability_derivation: Assume alpha<=beta and let S be the post-event report subset on which q>p. Full-law TV dominates beta*q(S)-alpha*p(S), which is at least beta*TV(p,q). Thus use max event mass.
